text:
Sara P.: Quick sync — SecureVault (secrets mgr) + KeyGrid (HSM vendor) partnership. Need to confirm SSO/SAML flow, SCIM user provisioning, and KMS passthrough for marketplace listing. Can we map owners?

Dylan M.: I can own SSO + SAML metadata. Timeline?

Maria L.: I’ll own marketplace listing and joint announcement copy. We need compatibility checklist from eng before product page.

Aj K.: I’ll take KMS/HSM runtime integration and cert exchange with KeyGrid.

Sara P.: Great. High level asks from SecureVault team: 1) SSO with SP-initiated SAML 2) SCIM v2 minimal attributes (email, name, groups) 3) KMS wrapping support for secrets at rest. They want GA by end of quarter.

Dylan M.: For SAML: ask them for IdP metadata XML and test IdP endpoint. We should provide our SP metadata too. Quick checklist: cert fingerprint, ACS URL, NameID format, attribute mappings.

Maria L.: Marketing timeline: embargo date 2026-06-15, press on 06-22. Need final feature matrix by 06-05.

Aj K.: KeyGrid requires mutual TLS for KMS passthrough and an HSM attestation cert. Also want a small integration test harness they can run.

Sara P.: Action items: @Dylan generate SP metadata + SSO test plan; @Aj spec KMS mTLS handshake + sample test; @Maria draft marketplace blurb & joint announcement outline. I’ll coordinate partner comms and legal checklist.

Dylan M.: Start of SAML sample (will share in repo):
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://redwood.example.com\">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned=\"true\">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST\" Location=\"https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs\"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
I’ll drop full metadata to the partner slack thread.

Aj K.: KMS passthrough minimal example for partner test:
```
curl -X POST https://redwood-kms.example.com/wrap \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"key_id":"keygrid-hsm-01","plaintext_key":"<base64>"}' \
  --cert client.crt --key client.key --cacert keygrid-ca.pem
```
We should supply client certs from our integration CA or use their test certs.

Maria L.: For marketplace page: please confirm supported combos (SSO+SCIM required, KMS passthrough optional). Also need a short compatibility note for on-prem/private deployments.

Dylan M.: SCIM mapping: we recommend minimal v2 mapping: `userName -> email`, `name.givenName`, `name.familyName`, `groups` -> team attribute. We should include a sample PATCH for group assignment.

Sara P.: Partner asks about billing & entitlements in marketplace (how to surface dedicated vs hosted). Maria — can you propose a UI mock for marketplace listing that shows both hosted API and dedicated HSM-backed offering?

Maria L.: Yep. Mock by EOD Wed. Also will draft joint announcement timeline and who gets quoted. Sara — do we want KeyGrid CTO and SecureVault Head of Product quoted?

Sara P.: Yes, those two + Redwood Head of Solutions. Legal to sign off on quotes.

Aj K.: One more technical: KeyGrid wants us to support HKDF-based key wrapping scheme (RFC 5869 derivative). I’ll add compatibility test vector to repo.

Dylan M.: I’ll schedule a 30m technical integration call with both partner engineering teams — propose Thu 10am PT. Who’s in?

Sara P.: In.

Maria L.: In.

Aj K.: In.

MarketplaceBot: New external invite created for partners@securevault.com and devops@keygrid.io — meeting link: https://meet.example.com/abc-123

Sara P.: Perfect. I’ll update the partner onboarding doc and request SCIM test tenant credentials from SecureVault. Please push any PG/KO blockers here. :thumbsup:
